transcript: Give me 40 seconds, not to calm your fear, but to shut down the signal that creates it. Fear is not in your thoughts, it is in your nervous system. That's why logic doesn't help when fear hits. So do this with me now. Inhale through your nose. Pause. Take a second short inhale, just a little more air. Now, long slow exhale through the mouth. Again, inhale, top it up, long exhale, one more time. This breath tells your body there is no danger right now. When the body feels safe, fear collapses on its own. You don't fight fear, you remove its fuel. Use this breath whenever fear appears, before a conversation, before action, before sleep. Fear is a signal, not a command. And when the body learns safety, the mind follows. If you want to retrain fear at its root, through breath, body and awareness, my ebook, Time to Heal, is in the link on my profile. Be gentle, you are not broken, you are rewiring. If this exercise helped you even a little, imagine what 30 days of guided practices like this can do. That's why I created the 30 day healing journey, to retrain fear from the body, not the mind. It's waiting for you in the link on my profile.
